Claim: session `session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S` · branch `claude/issue-8464-summary-chip-object-value`

PM dispatch (`domain:ui` seat). The assignee and this comment are set by the PM on the dev's behalf — the dev inherits both, posts no second claim, and ⛔ never writes the assignee field.

## The defect

`packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx`, the `effectiveSummaryFields.map` render **beside the page H1**. Unlike every other band of the record page, that chip has **no type-aware renderer** — `String(val)` with special cases only for currency, date/datetime, percent and select/status/multiselect.

⇒ an object-valued summary field (an expanded lookup payload, a location, an address) renders a Badge reading **`[object Object]` next to the H1**, and its **`aria-label` carries the same text**. Reachable **both** ways: `schema.summaryFields` is author-declared and **never filtered by type**, and the auto-detection can pick a select field whose stored value is an array.

## ⭐ Two siblings landed today — read them before choosing

Neither existed when this card was filed, and both bear directly on the arms:

- **objectui#8596 / PR #8679** (merged) — the `{}` cell-value census across all 53 registered types. ⭐ It established the repo's method for exactly this question: **read `valueSchemaFor` per family and let the spec decide**, never invent a renderer-side fallback. It also found two answers that were **the opposite of the obvious one** (`user` prints what `lookup` prints; `file`/`video`/`audio` take the empty affordance because `FileValueSchema` names `url` as required).
- **objectui#8434 / PR #8698** — the unresolved `user` reference. ⭐ Same shape one band over, and its finding is the one to carry: the renderer serves **two populations** it cannot distinguish, so the affordance had to be **epistemic** rather than a claim.

⚠️ Both are precedent for **A**, ⛔ but neither makes A free — see below.

## The choice: **A or C**, decided by measurement. ⛔ B is fenced.

- **A — route the chip through `getCellRenderer`**, the way `HeaderHighlight` does. Consistent with every other band, and address/location/lookup formatting for free.
- **C — a narrow stringifier for the chip.** ⚠️ Same per-kind product questions, and objectui#8395's write-up calls this shape **answer-shopping**.
- ⛔ **B — skip object values — is REFUSED.** *"It removes a chip an author explicitly asked for, silently."* That is the silent-drop shape objectstack#4001 rules out and objectui#8057's triage re-adopted this week. ⛔ Not available, and ⛔ not a fallback if A turns out awkward.

⚠️ **The card's own warning, and it is the reason this is not a one-liner:**

> **Do not assume A is free.** A Badge is a much smaller surface than a cell; **some renderers may not fit inside one**, and this needs **measuring per kind rather than assuming**.

⇒ **measure every field kind rendered inside the Badge** and report the table. If some kinds do not fit, that is the finding, and the answer may be *A for the kinds that fit, with a stated rule for the rest* — ⛔ but say so with the measurement, never as a hedge.

## ⭐ The measurement that settles it, from objectui#8395

> objectui#8395 established **on this exact page** that *"render what the user sees"* and *"render the underlying value"* give **different answers per field type**, and that the intuitive choice was **wrong for 9 of 17 types**.

⇒ that table already exists. **Read it, re-derive it against today's tree, and say which of the two questions this chip is asking.** A chip beside the H1 is a *summary* — arguably it should show what the reader sees elsewhere on the page — but ⛔ that is an argument, not a measurement, and the 9-of-17 result is why arguments lose here.

## Evidence bar

1. ⭐ **Leg 1**: render the chip today with an object-valued summary field and show the Badge text **and its `aria-label`** both reading `[object Object]`. ⛔ The card was filed from another dev's measurement on a different branch — **reproduce it**.
2. the fix renders the same field as the rest of the page does (or as your measurement rules), by concrete assertion on the rendered text;
3. ⭐ **the non-regression axis**: the chip's **emptiness classification must not move.** objectui#8394 / PR #8457 converged that guard onto the shared `hasCellValue` authority as *"the non-regressive convergence — it moves whitespace-only strings and nothing else."* ⛔ Your change is a **display** decision and must leave that alone. Pin it.
4. **caricature, both directions**: *"render nothing for every object"* and *"render every value through the cell renderer regardless of kind"* — both must redden loudly.

⚠️ **An assertion never observed to fail has not been tested.** Every pin must be observed red under one of the caricatures.

- **Ablation:** mutate a READ SITE (never a pin), from a committed tree, `trap` on EXIT/INT/TERM with absolute paths, proving the mutation on disk **in both directions** (anchor counts AND `git hash-object` vs the HEAD blob) **plus a line-total gate**; restore **by state** (`git diff HEAD` empty; `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH`, never the bare form). **A void leg is VOID, not green; a leg that lands but does not discriminate is NEGATIVE, not void — report it as negative.**
- ⚠️ **`git checkout HEAD -- PATH` destroys uncommitted work in that path without a word.** Commit your own edits first — that cost a redo on PR #8713 tonight.
- **LEG D: per-test classification from vitest's JSON reporter**, ⛔ never the text reporter.
- ⚠️ **`.rounded-full` matches TWO nodes per avatar** (Radix `Avatar.Root` **and** `AvatarFallback`) — objectui#8596's census navigated with `querySelector` and never noticed; **counting does**. If your measurement counts rendered nodes, verify each selector matches exactly one.
- ⚠️ `queryByText` throws on **multiple** matches as well as none; happy-dom reports `clientWidth: 0` and never fires container-size effects.

## objectui traps (measured, carry them)

- Run vitest **from the repo root with paths**. Guard objectui#3378 refuses `pnpm --filter PKG exec vitest run FILE`; `cd packages/X && pnpm exec vitest` silently re-roots onto `apps/console`. ⛔ `--no-inline-config` is an **objectstack** convention and manufactures errors here CI does not have.
- ⚠️ The `@objectstack/spec` **root export is thin** — `FieldSchema` and friends live on subpaths (`/data`, `/automation`). An import yielding `undefined` is a **specifier problem, not evidence a symbol is absent**; it fails toward *"nothing to do."*
- ⚠️ Type-check with the dependency closure built; an unbuilt tree gives `TS2307` for every workspace import — a **PRECONDITION**, recorded **NOT MEASURED**.
- ⚠️ **`.at(-1)` is TS2550** in packages inheriting the root `lib: ["ES2020"]` (objectui#8691); jest-dom matchers are untyped in some test programs (objectui#8714).
- ⚠️ `search_issues` returns **false zeros** here — and **this card's own dedup was never run** (the reporting dev was rate-limited and REST answered 403). ⛔ **Do not inherit its "no dedup claim" as a clean bill.** Suggested query: `DetailView summaryFields chip String(val) object badge`. Declare your channel and whether its control fired; if neither works, **report rather than filing blind**.

## Collisions

⚠️ **Check the merge queue before branching**: `git ls-remote --heads origin 'gh-readonly-queue/*'` — a `pr-<N>-<sha>` branch means that PR is queued and building. PR #8685 (`plugin-detail`, masked-row copy) has **landed**, so the package is free; ⛔ stop and report if your change reaches a file a queued PR touches.
